messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature

message.content:
**The best months to visit Hawaii are typically late spring (April–May) and early fall (September–October).**

| Why these months are ideal | What you’ll experience |
|----------------------------|------------------------|
| **Mild, comfortable temperatures** – average highs around 80 °F (27 °C) and lows around 65 °F (18 °C). | Warm, sunny days perfect for beach‑time, snorkeling, and hiking. |
| **Lower crowds** – the peak summer season (June–August) and holiday periods (Christmas, New Year, Fourth of July) attract the most visitors. | More relaxed resorts, easier to book activities, and better chances of snagging a good deal. |
| **Great surf & ocean conditions** – the trade winds are still strong enough for good waves, but the water is still warm. | Ideal for surfing, stand‑up paddleboarding, and other water sports. |
| **Blooming flora** – the islands’ tropical plants are in full bloom, adding color to hikes and scenic drives. | Beautiful scenery for photography and nature walks. |
| **Good deals on accommodations** – rates are usually lower than in the high‑summer season. | More budget‑friendly options for hotels, vacation rentals, and tours. |

### Quick weather snapshot (average monthly temperatures)

| Month | Avg. High (°F) | Avg. Low (°F) |
|-------|----------------|---------------|
| April | 81 | 66 |
| May   | 82 | 67 |
| June  | 84 | 68 |
| July  | 85 | 69 |
| August| 85 | 69 |
| September | 84 | 68 |
| October | 82 | 67 |

*(These figures are averages for the island of Oʻahu; temperatures are similar across the other main islands.)*

---

**Bottom line:** If you’re looking for a balance of pleasant weather, fewer crowds, and better prices, aim for **late April through May or September through early October**. If you’re a big‑budget traveler who doesn’t mind crowds and higher prices, the summer months (June–August) still offer great sunshine and plenty of events, but expect the busiest times of the year.
